beats: Every night, feature clips just sat there — a static screen while a voice narrated over it.
Meanwhile the nightly news digest already used real motion graphics — title cards, counters, callouts.
So the same Remotion pipeline that builds the news digest now builds the feature clips too.
One shared grammar file plans a motion effect per voice beat — like handing the clips the news show's own editor.
One engineering build now powers two products instead of one.
